description:
## Problem

UrlValidator.dangerous_host? accepts an optional config parameter for logging, but most callers do not pass it. This means most validation failures are silently swallowed with no logging.

## What to do

1. Either make config required in dangerous_host? and update all callers, or
2. Use a module-level config accessor (like other modules do) instead of parameter passing
3. Ensure all validation failures are logged consistently
4. Run specs to verify

## Why

- Reliability: silent validation failures make debugging harder
- Consistency: some paths log, others dont
- The optional parameter pattern is error-prone
title: Fix inconsistent logging in UrlValidator.dangerous_host?
